labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports test failures with Pygments 2.21.0; not yet reproducible.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example, Rich version or test names given.

body:
Thanks for the report. To look into this, we need a minimal runnable example that reproduces the failing tests with Pygments 2.21.0. The name of the failing test(s) and the assertion diff are enough; there is no need to paste the full pytest log.

Please also include:

- The Rich version you are building (`python -m rich.diagnose` prints this along with your environment).
- The Python version and the exact Pygments version installed.

A similar earlier report for Pygments 2.16.1 is #3088.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
